sources.title: [2609.04172] Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models ...
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Existing work has mainly studied its algorithmic behavior, leaving the role of training data unclear. We examine this role at the data-minimal limit by training on a single query.
